name: Development (design and integration)
description: The system is designed, built up from components, integrated and qualified.
typical_enabling_system: Development environment, tooling, test beds and the team that uses them

name: Manufacturing or production
description: Units of the system are produced or assembled repeatedly to the qualified design.
typical_enabling_system: Production line, supply chain, build and packaging process

name: Deployment
description: The system is delivered, installed and brought into its operating environment.

name: Training
description: People who will operate, use, maintain or support the system are trained.
typical_enabling_system: Training materials, trainers, simulators or practice environments

name: Operations, maintenance and support
description: The system performs its mission while being operated, maintained, supplied and supported.
typical_enabling_system: Operating environment, maintenance and support organization, supply channels

name: Refinement (improvement and upgrade)
description: The system is improved, extended or adapted to new needs and technologies during its life.
typical_enabling_system: Upgrade process, change control and re-qualification means

name: Retirement
description: The system is withdrawn from service, removed, and disposed of or recycled.
typical_enabling_system: Removal, data or material recovery and disposal process
